description:
Create the lernie binary and implement 'lernie new <path>'.

=== What to build ===
- Add src/main.rs declaring a [[bin]] or rely on default binary target with Cargo.toml; pick one and note in commit.
- Argument parsing via clap (or argh / lexopt — pick one lightweight, justify in commit).
- 'lernie new <path>':
  1. Refuses if <path> exists and is non-empty.
  2. Copies the template/ directory (from bl-c91c) to <path>.
  3. Runs 'git init' in <path>.
  4. Creates an initial commit 'init conversation repo' staging everything in the template.
  5. Writes .agent/version contents matching ARCH §10 schema version.

=== Out of scope ===
- 'prompt' subcommand (separate subtask).
- Validating the template against schemas (bl-5bbc covers load-and-validate; this task uses the template as-is).

=== Testing ===
- Integration test under tests/: invoke the binary against a tempdir, assert directory layout matches ARCH §2.2, assert git log has exactly one commit.

Depends on bl-c91c.
